授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 心理学研究法の概説を行う．初めに，心理学研究法の論理，研究のプロセス，変数の種類，研究法の概説，その他の重要概念等の説明を行う．次に，異なった研究法（行動観察法・フィールドワーク法，実験法，質問紙調査法）を取り上げ，まずそれぞれの研究法の講義（１コマ）を行った後，実際に実習（１コマ）を通してその方法を実体験する．また、心理学実験の発表会を見ることで，発表の仕方を学ぶ．
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course is designed to introduce 2nd year undergraduates to the basic research methods of psychological science, including methods of behavioral observation, field work, experiments, and questionnaire/survey.  First, we survey basic concepts related to research methods (such as, science, psychological science, research processes/stages, research ethics, itc.).  Then, each of th 4 basic research methods will be, first, conceptually surveyed and, then, followed by hands-on experience session.  Finally, students will be provided an oppportunity to learn observationally how to present research findings in a semi-formal way, by attending the poster presentations of "Psychological Experiment" by the current 3rd-year students.
